review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 Poly建模方向 1. 完成高质量SubD建模，搭建良好的拓扑结构。 2. 将Poly数据转换并整合至Alias工作流，保持设计特征及曲面质量。 3. 理解汽车设计开发流程，能够根据草图快速构建设计方案。 4. 具备较强读图能力，准确理解设计师设计意图，熟悉汽车内外饰设计语言。 5. 直接与设计师沟通，根据反馈快速修改，主动提出合理解决方案。 汽车和产品渲染方向 1. 负责外饰CG渲染、产品效果图渲染，输出高品质静帧。 2. 具备良好的审美能力，理解设计师表达需求，独立完成颜色与材质表现，精准还原材质效果。 3. 了解设计部门出图流程，根据项目节点快速交付，具备后期修图经验。 4. 根据实物样品准确还原颜色，理解CMF设计需求，做好色彩偏差控制。 5. 独立制作及调整材质纹理，熟悉金属、塑料、皮革、织物等常见汽车材质表现。 任职要求 Poly建模方向 1. 软件要求：至少掌握Blender、Maya、3ds Max、Alias SubD其中一款软件。 2. 能够完成高质量SubD建模，拥有良好的拓扑结构。 3. 可实现Poly数据转换并整合至Alias工作流，保留设计特征及曲面质量。 4. 理解汽车设计开发流程，可依据草图快速构建设计方案，读图能力较强。 5. 能够理解设计师设计意图，熟悉汽车内外饰设计语言。 6. 可直接对接设计师沟通，接收反馈快速修改，能够主动提出合理解决方案。 汽车和产品渲染方向 1. 软件要求：熟练使用Blender（优先考虑）、VRED、Unreal Engine。 2. 可完成外饰CG渲染、产品效果图渲染、高品质静帧输出工作。 3. 具备良好审美能力，理解设计师需求，独立完成颜色与材质表现，精准还原材质效果。 4. 熟悉设计部门出图流程，可按照项目节点快速交付，拥有后期修图经验。 5. 能够依据实物样品准确还原颜色，理解CMF设计需求，具备色彩偏差控制能力。 6. 可独立制作及调整材质纹理，熟悉金属、塑料、皮革、织物等常见汽车材质表现。 PS: 汽车与产品渲染能力为核心要求，需达到较高专业水平； Poly建模能力需能够满足日常设计开发项目需求即可，要求可适当放宽。 英语读写即可

We provide opportunities for professional development, and our team members are encouraged to bring new ideas and approaches to their work. Our company is dedicated to fostering a culture of inclusiveness and respect where every employee feels valued and supported.

review_candidates.description: Who We Are International Justice Mission (IJM) is a global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. The Need For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Communications Associate to ensure IJM’s stakeholder audience is engaged in the fight to end Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children by providing an array of products and resources like reports, brochures, website and other creative collaterals. This role cultivates the need to build a network of creative storytellers and resource materials to develop and champion stories related to CSEC and IJM’s protection model. The Associate will provide coaching and feedback to deliver a global standard of messaging for IJM staff and partners. This individual will oversee brand protocols and ensure that brand guidelines are followed. The Associate will produce content for internal and external stakeholders that will bring the required impact. Create a process flow for field information to be captured and recorded in a content management bank. Produce high-quality content such as stories, and factual data that can be leveraged by teams. The role is based in Dhaka, but will provide support nationally, including travelling to each of IJM’s future program locations (Khulna, Barisal and Mymensingh). Responsibilities: Strategy & Knowledge Development & Implementation: Develop content strategy that is driven by fulfilling key stakeholders- IJM and Partners while maintaining creative excellence. Create new opportunities for organization growth in creative spaces. Coach those inside and outside of the creative team in high-level storytelling, writing, podcasting, and communication principles. Maintain a library of resources to equip regional staff to talk about IJM’s work effectively and efficiently. Networking & Partnership: Develop and maintain relationships with influencers and thought leaders, eventually driving them to participate in the work of IJM. Participate in opportunities (i.e. Keynote speaking, being interviewed, etc.) that broaden the reach of IJM. Find, vet, and lead contract creatives in excellent and groundbreaking storytelling. Communication: Lead creative team in consistent, effective, and strategic written and spoken communication. Create concepts that encompass organizational needs and practical execution for deliverables. Lead and coach the creative team in excellent internal communication via pitches, proposals, and concept decks. Events and Logistics: With the creative team, conceptualize event program flow and execution. Lead in developing key communication moments in events. (i.e. Keynote speaker prep, filmed storytelling prep). Participate in executing logistics for events as they pertain to the creative team. Qualification Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in English, Journalism, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in journalism, editorial roles, or corporate communications Ability to work both independently and with a team. Proactively seek and hear storylines throughout the company and present them in a collaborative way. Must possess excellent organizational and planning skills. Strong knowledge and understanding of current trends on the issue of CSEC. Technical Competencies: Creative Writing and graphic proficiency. Project management competency. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Acrobat and MAC systems. Critical Competencies: Creative & Collaborative Innovative & Strategic Thinking Service-Oriented & Agile Other Duties: This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities for the position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. All positions are required to perform any additional tasks assigned by the supervisor Application Process: Upload Resume & Cover Letter in one PDF document and send the application to bangladeshrecruitment@ijm.org IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assessing the candidate's value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes.

review_candidates.title: Chief Executive Officer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Located in the heart of Northwest British Columbia, the Gitxsan Nation is a proud and resilient people whose history, culture, and stewardship of their traditional Lax'Yip territory stretches back countless generations. Guided by the Gitxsan Ayookw (traditional laws), the Nation has maintained a deep connection to its lands, waters, and communities while continuing to build a strong vision for the future. It spans the basin and watersheds of the upper Skeena River, including the Kispiox, Bulkley, and Babine rivers, centering around the Hazelton, Terrace, and Smithers. Today, the Gitxsan are creating new opportunities for economic growth and prosperity while remaining firmly grounded in their cultural values, governance traditions, and responsibilities to future generations. Gitxsan Development Corporation (GDC) plays a central role in realizing that vision. Established to advance economic opportunities on behalf of the Gitxsan Nation, GDC is more than a collection of businesses. It is a vehicle for economic self-determination, community prosperity, and long-term nation building. Guided by the principle of being "a stitch in the blanket towards the Gitxsan Nation's economic independence," GDC works to create meaningful employment, develop local talent, generate sustainable revenues, and build business partnerships that create lasting benefits for Gitxsan members and communities. Under the direction of the Board of Directors, the organization continues to advance a diverse range of initiatives designed to create economic benefits, employment opportunities, and long-term value for the community while remaining grounded in Indigenous values, culture, and community priorities. PURPOSE To achieve long-term economic independence, prosperity, and self-determination for the Gitxsan Nation through sustainable business development, strategic partnerships, and opportunities that honour Gitxsan laws, values, and stewardship of the land. OUR COMMITMNENTS The Corporation Is Dedicated To Economic independence for the Gitxsan Nation Sustainable economic growth and prosperity Job creation and training opportunities for Gitxsan people Balancing economic opportunity with stewardship of Gitxsan Lax Yip (traditional territory) Operating in accordance with Gitxsan Ayookw (traditional laws and governance principles) Building prosperity for current and future generations GUIDING PRINCIPALS Community Prosperity – Commitment to creating economic opportunities that support the long-term well-being and prosperity of Gitxsan Nation Members. Sustainability – Focus on responsible development that balances economic success with environmental stewardship and respect for future generations. Partnership & Collaboration – Building strong relationships with community members, governments, industry partners, neighbouring First Nations, and stakeholders to achieve shared success. Innovation & Growth – Pursuing new business opportunities, creative solutions, and continuous improvement to strengthen economic self-sufficiency and community resilience. Respect for Culture and Values – Ensuring all economic development initiatives honour and reflect the culture, traditions, and aspirations of the Gitxsan Nation. Download the Full Job Description: Position Profile Gitxsan Dev Corp - Chief Executive Officer.pdf Position Overview Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is responsible for providing the strategic, operational, financial, and cultural leadership required to guide GDC through its next stage of growth, opportunity, and long-term community impact. The CEO will work closely with the Board, Gitxsan leadership, subsidiary managers, staff, community members, partners, and external stakeholders to execute strategic priorities, evaluate and advance new business opportunities, strengthen existing operations, and ensure the organization remains accountable to its mandate, governance framework, and community objectives. As the senior leader of the organization, the CEO will be responsible for fostering a strong, transparent, and productive relationship with the Board of Directors. This includes providing regular and meaningful updates on organizational performance, financial results, strategic initiatives, risks, and emerging opportunities, while ensuring the Board is equipped with the information required to make informed decisions. Success in the role will require disciplined governance practices, clear communication, sound judgment, and a commitment to accountability and transparency. The CEO will oversee a diverse portfolio of business interests and subsidiaries, ensuring strong financial stewardship, operational performance, risk management, and alignment with GDC's long-term strategic vision. The CEO will support the Board in advancing sustainable economic development opportunities that create lasting value for the Gitxsan Nation while building and maintaining strong relationships with Hereditary Chiefs, community leaders, government agencies, Indigenous partners, industry stakeholders, and prospective business partners. While the position offers flexibility through a hybrid work arrangement, the CEO will be expected to maintain a meaningful presence within the community and across the territory to foster trust, strengthen relationships, and remain connected to the priorities and aspirations of the Gitxsan Nation. This role requires an individual who can balance strategic vision with practical execution and who possesses the experience and leadership capability to guide a growing organization through increasing complexity and opportunity. Beyond delivering business results, the CEO will be expected to champion workforce development, support the growth of Gitxsan talent, mentor future leaders, and help ensure that economic opportunities translate into meaningful, long-term benefits for current and future generations of Gitxsan people. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Lead the development and execution of the organization's strategic plan and annual business objectives Identify, evaluate, and advance new economic development opportunities, partnerships, investments, and business ventures Ensure organizational priorities align with the long-term vision, values, and objectives established by the Board Provide recommendations to the Board regarding growth opportunities, investments, and strategic initiatives Advance opportunities that create sustainable economic benefits, employment, and long-term prosperity for the Gitxsan Nation Governance & Board Relations Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with the Board of Directors Provide timely and accurate reporting on organizational performance, key initiatives, opportunities, and risks Support informed decision-making by preparing board materials, business cases, recommendations, and strategic updates Serve as the primary link between the Board and the organization, ensuring open, transparent, and proactive communication on strategic, operational, and financial matters Ensure a clear distinction between governance responsibilities and operational management Operational Leadership Provide overall leadership and direction for day-to-day operations Develop organizational systems, processes, and performance standards that support efficiency, accountability, and long-term sustainability Foster a culture of collaboration, professionalism, continuous improvement, and service excellence Ensure organizational activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and governance requirements Financial Management Oversee organizational budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities Ensure effective stewardship and management of organizational resources Monitor organizational performance against approved budgets and business plans Support sustainable financial growth through sound risk management and strategic decision-making Relationship Building & Community Engagement Act as the primary ambassador for the organization Build productive relationships with Indigenous communities, governments, funding agencies, business leaders, and industry stakeholders Maintain a strong and visible presence within the community Navigate the intersection of business priorities, governance, culture, and community expectations in a respectful and collaborative manner Communicate organizational goals, achievements, and opportunities to community members and stakeholders People Leadership Recruit, mentor, develop, and retain a high-performing team Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and mutual respect Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives Champion the development of Gitxsan talent and future leaders while fostering opportunities for workforce participation and capacity building Create an organizational environment that empowers staff to succeed IDEAL CANDIDATE ATTRIBUTES The successful candidate will be a collaborative and respected leader who combines business acumen with strong relationship-building skills and a genuine commitment to Indigenous community development. Operate as the strategic thinker who can maximise current economic opportunities and effectively identify prospects while maintaining focus on operational excellence and organizational performance. Be comfortable working with Boards and governance structures and have demonstrated success leading organizations through growth and change. Demonstrating credibility, professionalism, and strong interpersonal skills will be essential to building trust among community members, staff, leadership, stakeholders, and external partners. Education And Experience Requirements Education and Professional Background A university degree in business administration, commerce, finance, public administration, economic development, or a related discipline is preferred. An equivalent combination of education, training, and senior leadership experience will also be considered. A minimum of five years of progressive managerial or senior leadership experience is required. Demonstrated experience in a senior leadership role, particularly in a dynamic, growth-oriented, community-accountable, or Indigenous governance environment. Required Experience And Capabilities Advanced knowledge of First Nation governance, administration, and Indigenous economic development. Proven success in Indigenous economic development, business development, community economic development, or related sectors, with the ability to balance economic, social, cultural, and environmental objectives Experience working with a Board of Directors, Chief and Council, or comparable governance structure. Able to distinguish between governance and operational management and to support effective decision-making at both levels. Senior leadership experience, including leadership, coaching, team development, succession planning, and organizational growth Experience leading the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of organizational policies, procedures, and governance frameworks. Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, capital planning, investment analysis, risk management, and corporate governance. Experience developing, negotiating, and managing joint ventures, partnerships, or other complex strategic relationships. Knowledge of natural resource development, major infrastructure, construction, or land-based economic development initiatives is considered an asset. Proven ability to think strategically and creatively, assess opportunities, solve complex problems, and move priorities from concept to execution. Strong leadership, team building, negotiation, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear board reports, briefing materials, business cases, and funding submissions. Leader Competencies Strategic Thinking Relationship Building Financial Acumen Negotiation & Influencing Community Engagement Business Development Governance Awareness People Leadership Communication & Public Speaking Change Leadership Cultural Awareness Demonstrated cultural competency and experience working with Indigenous communities; knowledge of Gitxsan history, governance, culture, and community priorities is considered an asset. WHY JOIN? This is a unique opportunity to lead a growing and community-focused organization at a pivotal stage in its evolution. The Successful Candidate Will Have The Opportunity To Shape the future direction of the organization Drive meaningful economic and community impact Work closely with an engaged Board and leadership team Advance Indigenous economic development and community prosperity Build lasting partnerships and sustainable opportunities for future generations Compensation Competitive salary $180-220,000/annum Housing option may be provided by GDC Benefits WORK ARRANGEMENT The organization recognizes that exceptional candidates may reside outside the immediate community. The successful candidate is expected to maintain a regular and meaningful presence within the community and participate in organizational meetings, Board meetings, stakeholder engagement activities, and community events. Flexible arrangements may be considered for the right candidate, including travel support and scheduled in-community work periods as mutually agreed upon. This reflects discussion had within the community on what they would like to see from the new CEO regarding a regular community presence. review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager – Solar PV & BESS
review_candidates.description: Travel: Regular travel across Europe Employment type: Full-time or contract Reporting to: Managing Partner About AMA Invest AMA Invest is an international investment firm deploying capital into renewable energy infrastructure across Europe, Ukraine, and Southeast Asia. We are building a portfolio of utility-scale and commercial & industrial solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. Our investment strategies include project acquisition, co-development, joint ventures, and project financing. About the Role We are looking for a commercially driven Business Development Manager to originate, evaluate, and advance solar PV and BESS investment opportunities. This is primarily a deal-origination role. You will be responsible for building a qualified pipeline of projects and moving the strongest opportunities from initial contact through preliminary due diligence, commercial negotiations, and investment approval. We are particularly interested in candidates who already have an active network among project developers, EPC contractors, utilities, landowners, and infrastructure investors. Key Responsibilities Project Origination and Pipeline Development ●      Originate utility-scale and commercial & industrial solar PV and BESS opportunities across target markets. ●      Identify late-stage and ready-to-build projects with secured land rights, grid connection, permits, technical studies, and a viable route to market. ●      Source projects through developers, EPC contractors, utilities, landowners, brokers, advisers, and infrastructure investors. ●      Identify turnkey EPC and developer-led opportunities requiring equity, debt financing, or a strategic investment partner. ●      Build and maintain a structured pipeline covering project stage, capacity, investment requirement, expected returns, key risks, and next steps. ●      Monitor grid capacity, electricity prices, renewable-energy auctions, corporate PPA demand, ancillary-services markets, and other factors affecting project economics. Opportunity Screening and Commercial Assessment ●      Conduct initial screening of project economics, including CAPEX, expected generation, storage revenue assumptions, operating costs, financing requirements, and potential investment returns. ●      Assess the status and quality of land rights, permits, grid connection, offtake arrangements, EPC proposals, and development timelines. ●      Identify key technical, regulatory, commercial, and counterparty risks at an early stage. ●      Prepare concise investment teasers, screening materials, and recommendations for the investment team. ●      Coordinate financial, technical, legal, tax, and regulatory due diligence with internal and external advisers. Relationship and Stakeholder Management ●      Develop long-term relationships with renewable-energy developers, EPC contractors, utilities, infrastructure funds, banks, advisers, landowners, and public authorities. ●      Build a proprietary network capable of generating recurring, off-market investment opportunities. ●      Represent AMA Invest at energy conferences, trade fairs, industry associations, and investor forums. ●      Maintain disciplined follow-up and provide regular pipeline and market updates to the Managing Partner. Candidate Profile Required Experience and Capabilities ●      4–8 years of experience in renewable-energy project development, infrastructure investment, project finance, or energy-sector business development. ●      Demonstrable track record of originating, developing, financing, or closing solar PV, BESS, or related infrastructure transactions. ●      Strong understanding of the project-development lifecycle, including land rights, permitting, grid connection, technical development, EPC procurement, financing, construction, and operations. ●      Ability to assess project quality and commercial viability quickly, using incomplete information when necessary. ●      Experience conducting commercial negotiations with developers, EPC contractors, investors, lenders, or project owners. ●      Strong financial and commercial judgement, including an understanding of project returns, capital structures, and key value drivers. ●      Ability to work independently, build relationships from scratch, and take ownership of opportunities through multiple stages. ●      Excellent written and spoken English. ●      Willingness to travel regularly across target markets. Preferred ●      An existing network of solar PV and BESS developers, EPC contractors, infrastructure investors, utilities, or project advisers. ●      Direct experience in one or more target markets in Europe, Ukraine, Thailand, or wider Southeast Asia. ●      Experience with project finance, equity investment, joint ventures, co-development agreements, or M&A transactions. ●      Understanding of BESS revenue models, including energy arbitrage, ancillary services, capacity payments, balancing markets, and co-location with renewable generation. ●      Experience originating proprietary or off-market investment opportunities. ●      Additional European or Asian language skills. What Success Looks Like During the first 12 months, the successful candidate will be expected to: ●      Build a qualified and actionable pipeline of solar PV and BESS projects. ●      Establish direct relationships with leading developers, EPC contractors, utilities, and investment partners in priority markets. ●      Present investment-ready opportunities supported by clear commercial analysis and risk assessment. ●      Progress selected opportunities into exclusivity, formal due diligence, investment approval, and financial close. ●      Create a repeatable project-origination process rather than relying solely on brokers and publicly marketed opportunities.
